verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents its own data import feature ('Import data from spreadsheets for free'), which can bring records over from another CRM's exports. Nothing shows a dedicated CRM-to-CRM migration tool or that owners and activity history carry over. The Bulk Write API (up to 25,000 records per call) is a developer building block, not a migration capability, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented migration wizard for other CRMs, preservation of record owners, preservation of activity/history, and independent or hands-on migration corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate from another CRM with my records, owners, and history intact

citations.quote: Import data from spreadsheets for free.
